headline: STRIDELINE verified in prod and closed; FURLONG's gallop physics proven, shape tuning next
lede: Slot a finished the horse quarter: the Qwen4-test demo STRIDELINE is now prod-verified (byte-match) and closed, and its no-limit sibling FURLONG has a proven gait — planted hooves with measured zero slip and a loop that closes to 1e-14 metres — parked as a draft PR awaiting a proportions pass before shipping.

notes.text: #2147 closed: jalfern.com/retrogames/demos/horse.html byte-matches main (35,115 B); step-8 evidence posted on the issue.
Three SwiftShader traps named in one session: integer vertex attributes, a hand-typed mat4 inverse, and look-matrix signs — each fixed engine-proof (CPU skinning, rigid inverse, camera-basis sky).
#2182 stays building: draft PR #2191 with 4 checkpointed commits; the remaining work is anatomy tuning + the furlongcheck harness, both specced in the demo README.
